crime: In private, the fishmonger's daughter named her a favorite — a book of witch history that was not in the library. The next evening the whole table put the question to her, and she gave the same title; every girl had been in on the test. Through the laughter, the fishmonger's daughter told her that talking to her gave nothing back — no answer ever came.

On nights the course was fish, the guards laid a carving knife on the serving board and counted it back at hall-close. The fishmonger's daughter would take it up, bone the fish for her whole table in seconds, and set it back edge-out, the way her father kept them, every night.
That night she sat on at the long table as the hall thinned. The girls going out saw the fishmonger's daughter still sitting with her.

In the fishmonger's daughter's presence, her hands were the fishmonger's daughter's hands. She took the carving knife from the board; one stroke — the trade's own, fast and single — and the voice was gone before any cry.

With the death, the skill had left; her hands were her own. She wiped the knife, laid it back, and was gone before the guards came to collect. At hall-close: the fishmonger's daughter at the long table, one clean wound; the count perfect, the knife in its place.

The knife lay edge-in. In years at her father's stall, the fishmonger's daughter had never once set a knife backward; the whole hall had watched her do it right a hundred nights. Another hand had put it back.

The cut itself the girls knew — the dead girl's own single stroke, no hesitation, at an angle no self-dealt wound allows. Hands that could do exactly what hers could: the table had proven whose those were, laughing, over a book that did not exist. And the girls going out had seen her still at the table with the fishmonger's daughter.
fields.epitaph: Every laugh she ever laughed was someone else's.
execution: A raised basin of still black water at the center of the stand. Above it, a tilting board; she was bound face-down to it.
The board lowered by degrees. All the way down, the water held nothing but her own face.
Her face met the surface. The board lowered her under.
The water closed over her, and stilled.

magic.name: Echo Hands
magic.text: Whatever the person beside her can do, she can do exactly as well.
